Wallet list & coverage

* Flow includes only wallets flagged SmartMoney = Yes in Admin. Non-smart and unclassified wallets are excluded; Interested is an independent flag. Balance supports Smart money wallets, Smart money wallets flagged Interested, or the original HOOKED group. Each token and fixed membership has a separate history. Balances are read directly from Solana every five minutes, including wallets with no recent swaps. In Balance, yellow shows combined token holdings and grey shows token price. In Flow, only sampled swaps sent by the universe wallets are included. Historical balances, when available, are reconstructed from transactions of the discovered token accounts. Balance changes include transfers and do not establish buys or sells. Unavailable checks leave gaps. Wallet labels are user supplied.

    All-wallet balance history unavailable

    Turn on Smart* to measure holdings for the Smart universe or Interested Parties. All-wallet balance history requires an owner-wide index and is not available.

    How MC tiers are estimated

    For 5D candles, the Total column shows estimated USD volume assigned by closing MC, not net flow; Buy, Sell, trade count and average per swap are unavailable. Purple bars compare total volume across tiers; percentages use all returned candle volume as the denominator. Green and red bars compare observed buy and sell activity on the same scale. Current MC marks the latest reported valuation, and Busiest by volume marks the largest total-volume tier. A wick-only tier has unknown volume allocation. For observed swaps: estimated execution MC = swap price × supply implied by the latest reported MC and price, assuming unchanged supply. Tiers use the selected time window. A tier more than 4× from its USD-weighted middle MC is excluded if it has under 1% of the window's observed USD flow. Empty tiers are omitted and sparse neighbors may be merged. Color intensity is relative to visible tiers. This is a bounded swap sample, not complete market history or net capital inflow.

    Data coverage & calculation

    Token lookup uses GeckoTerminal and DEX Screener. Individual swaps come from GeckoTerminal, across up to 3 of the most liquid pools found per selected listing. Pools found through DEX Screener may not have swap data available in GeckoTerminal. Each request returns at most 300 recent swaps per pool from the past 24 hours. The 5D view can add swaps previously observed and retained in this browser (up to 4,000 steps); it cannot reconstruct swaps from before those visits, and it is not complete five-day market history. Smaller pools, unindexed tokens, other exchanges, and older swaps may be missing. Select all combines the shown search matches only; it does not establish that they are official versions of the same token.

    For a single listing, 5D also fetches historical 15-minute candles from its most liquid discovered pool. The chart and historical tier table use completed candles within five days; provider gaps and other pools remain outside this coverage. Volume is assigned by closing market cap, so tier amounts are approximations. Candle high/low ranges preserve wick-only tiers, whose volume allocation is unknown. Candle volume is never added to observed swaps. Buy/sell totals and the transaction table still filter the returned swap sample, not complete history. Combined flow adds USD values across your selected chains and contracts. Swaps between two selected contracts on the same chain are excluded from combined flow. Individual views still show those swaps. Net buy volume is observed buy USD volume minus observed sell USD volume, not total capital inflow or a price forecast. Multi-pool routes can contain multiple swap steps. Transaction groups keep these steps together without changing chart totals. Table filters apply to individual steps and do not change the charts. Token quantity and execution price describe each swap step. Transaction sender addresses may represent routers or smart accounts rather than individual traders.

    Size bands: S < $100; M $100–<$1,000; L $1,000–<$10,000; XL ≥ $10,000. Duplicate events are counted once per chain. Pool requests are shared when selected contracts use the same pool. Automatic refresh runs every 60 seconds while this page is visible. Up to two requests can overlap; request starts are paced to reduce rate limits. Pool discovery is cached for five minutes, and the shared source reuses swap observations for up to one minute. Switching listings cancels obsolete requests.
